title: Chapter 429
paragraphs: Chapter 429
124. Elders in Crisis (3)
In a dark forest where not even a single ray of sunlight seemed to penetrate, this place had long been rumored to be haunted by ghosts and demons.
[Mia!]
Jin was riding Shuri through the complex and gloomy forest path. There were no other companions.
Considering how complicated the path was, as if a maze would have been better, Jin thought he might have regretted coming here alone if it weren't for Shuri.
-Young master, I sincerely ask you to go with Lord Murakan.
-My lord, are you sure? If you go alone and he has ill intentions, securing an escape route won't be easy.
-Is there a reason you have to go alone?
Before leaving, all of his companions were equally concerned about Jin.
It was because they still couldn't fully trust the master of this land.
Vwooo, vwooo.
As the forest deepened, the gloomy and ominous ghost song became more intense from all around.
'Ghost Bird Song. What an amazingly fitting name.'
Although it was his first time actually visiting, as always, Shuri was able to find the way skillfully and arrive without getting lost.
Dark and massive.
That was the impression that came to mind when he came face to face with the castle that stood out of nowhere at the edge of the forest.
The thick fog couldn't cover the strange ghostly energy emanating from the Ghost Bird Castle.
Just standing in front of it made it hard to breathe due to the overflowing demonic energy.
It suddenly felt strange that he had actually defeated the owner of this tremendous castle, Rata Prochi.
After sending Shuri back to the base, Jin waited for the castle gate to open.
After a while, the gate opened, but it wasn't visible who had unlocked and swung open the thick iron gate.
It wasn't even clear if a person had opened it.
It seemed as if the wind or a ghost had opened it and passed by, and instead of a typical castle interior, another darkness came into view.
Stepping into it felt no different from jumping off a thousand-league cliff.
However, Jin didn't add any more strength to the hand on the hilt of the sword on his waist, and just strode forward.
In the midst of a nightmarish landscape caused by the more intense, layered Ghost Bird Castle and the chilling wind, suddenly a dark open space unfolded.
"You've worked hard, 12th generation."
Rata Prochi's familiar voice was heard.
Whether he had just fought a battle or had come from torturing the people imprisoned in the Ghost Bird Castle basement, Rata reeked of a strong, pungent smell of blood.
"The smell of blood is strong."
"Well, the work we do is not the most pleasant kind. Aren't you used to it by now?"
"I just tried to say it."
As he approached, Rata's face flickered in the light of the torch he was holding.
"I didn't expect you to come alone."
Rata was genuinely surprised that Jin had come to the Ghost Bird Castle alone.
Not only Rata, but all the other Ghost Corps members felt the same way.
At least since Rata became the Ghost Corps leader, no, even when Smarion Prochi was leading the Ghost Corps.
There was no one who had ever come to the Ghost Bird Castle alone.
When the leaders of Rune Kandel and Zifl held secret meetings, there were always a certain number of people with considerable combat power.
It was a matter of course.
Although they had maintained neutrality in their own way, the Ghost Corps was by no means a small influential force.
Especially in their headquarters, the Ghost Bird Castle, they undoubtedly had one of the top powers among neutral forces.
Even Biment recognized their autonomy rather than attacking the Ghost Bird Castle, which was located in their territory.
"Since the Ghost Corps took on the risk to fulfill my request, I should show this level of trust, shouldn't I?"
At those words, Rata nodded his head as if he was impressed.
Jin felt somewhat embarrassed by that reaction, but he didn't show it.
"Indeed, that's great. All right, let's write the contract."
Sending off the elders, Rata left a message to visit the Ghost Bird Castle immediately.
It was to write a single contract for the alliance.
The paper Rata handed to Jin was composed of the simplest sentences among the contracts Jin had received so far.
Also, it was unexpected content.
(Rata Prochi and his Ghost Corps will serve Jin Rune Kandel as their lord, and this is a matter that all the remaining Ghost Corps members have perfectly agreed upon.)
It was more like a loyalty oath than a contract.
"This paper is for forming a blood pact between a lord and his subordinates, not a simple alliance."
"…What is this?"
Jin had initially planned to form an alliance with the Ghost Corps and gradually build a strong bond in the future.
He had never expected this.
"Is it not to your liking?"
"No, that's not it. It's just a bit surprising."
"I had respect for you since the day I met you in the Black Emperor Castle, and then I thought Jin Rune Kandel was more fearsome than Rune Kandel. That's why I killed the elders."
From the day Rata met Jin in the Garden of Swords, he decided to serve him as his lord.
Along with the conviction that it was the only way for the Ghost Corps to survive in the 'new era'.
"And I am also like an absolute figure within the Ghost Corps. My will is the will of all ghosts, meaning that the Ghost Corps will become your most important force."
There are many leaders in the world, but those who receive absolute support from their subordinates are by no means numerous.
Rata was one of those exceptional leaders who was practically one with his subordinates.
Jin took out a dagger from his pocket.
As he drew a line on his palm and engraved a blood mark on the paper, Rata did the same with his own blood on the paper.
"I accept, Sir Rata."
"Follow me, my lord."
Following Rata into the central hall of the castle, the disciplined Ghost Corps members came into view.
There were easily thousands of mercenaries wearing black chainmail and maintaining a standing position.
Soon, Rata stood at the front of the empty line and faced Jin, raising his sword in salute.
The rest of the Ghost Corps members also raised their swords in unison.
It was the moment Jin became the new owner of the Ghost Corps.
It was also the moment when the Ghost Corps completely abandoned their neutrality for the first time.
"I will introduce the members to you gradually."
"Understood."
Jin looked at the written statement on the paper again.
The phrase 'All the remaining members of the Ghost Corps have perfectly agreed' caught his eye.
"Seeing these disciplined members, it seems that there's not much difference in the size of the Ghost Corps compared to usual. Were there many who opposed becoming blood brothers with me?"
"Some of those who served my father were opposed. In other words, the elders."
"Neither you nor I seem to have a good relationship with the elders. What happened to them?"
"They all left the Ghost Bird Castle."
"Do they have any special secrets or factors that could be weaknesses of the Ghost Corps?"
Rata showed a moment of hesitation at that question.
"I didn't expect you to think of that. Yes, there is. And it's a shameful story, but we haven't been able to deal with them yet. We're in pursuit."
"Several days have passed, so there's a high possibility that they've already surrendered to other forces and asked for protection."
"I'm sorry for showing you such a sloppy side from the beginning."
"No, it's fine. I'll also have some people look for the escaped elders just in case. Tell me what the weaknesses and secrets of the Ghost Bird Castle are that they know."
"There's a monster sealed in the lowest part of the Ghost Bird Castle's basement."
"…A monster?"
As Jin expressed his doubts, Rata continued his explanation with a bitter smile.

"It's a monster that we simply cannot handle at the moment. It has been trapped underground without eating anything for decades, yet it is still alive, and the seal that blocks it is weakening every year."
"It's like a monster that would appear in an old tale."
"You don't seem too surprised by this sudden information."
"That's because I've dealt with a sealed demon before."
Naturally, Jin expected that the sealed creature in the basement of Ghost Bird Castle would be a demon.
"How strong is it that you're saying even the Ghost Corps members can't handle it?"
"It's beyond measure. It's hard to explain... Would you like to take a look together?"
They followed Rata down the stairs to the basement. The deeper and longer they went down the stairs, the more Jin could feel the gloomy and malicious energy pressing down on his body.
'Was this the source of the thick ghost energy pervading the entire Ghost Bird Castle?'
It wasn't just the ghost energy that spread from the gloomy atmosphere of the castle and made it difficult to breathe.
"We're here."
Upon reaching the lowest level, they saw a huge iron door and a red seal engraved above it.
Although it was a type of seal Jin had never seen before, he could sense that humans were used as materials for it.
It also indicated that the seal had tremendous restraining power.
"This is..."

"Even the successive Ghost Corps commanders didn't know about this seal; only the elders did. This seal was created by the other elders, excluding those who escaped this time. They used themselves as materials."
As they approached the seal, they could feel the ghost energy pressing heavily on their bodies.
"You're saying this seal weakens every year?"
"Yes."
From that answer, Jin realized why Rata had proposed a blood alliance so quickly.
'If the monster beyond that seal is released, the Ghost Corps cannot survive unless they abandon the castle.'
Of course, the possibility of the seal being released immediately was low, and Rata's proposal for a blood alliance was not solely for this reason, but it was by no means a small issue.

"I showed you this place first, my lord, because it's currently the biggest and only problem for the Ghost Corps. It's a shameful story, but this seal could threaten the existence of the Ghost Corps."
Now that they were blood allies, they needed to discuss and solve this problem together.
Showing a weakness immediately after becoming allies may seem like a cunning or ridiculous move, but Jin didn't feel that way about Rata.
From the beginning, Rata had chosen Jin, not Runecandle, Zifel, the Royal Family, or Kinzel.
If Rata had sided with Runecandle or Zifel instead of Jin, there would have been a higher possibility of resolving this seal issue more easily.
"Indeed... I can feel it just from the energy seeping out of the seal. What kind of demon is sealed inside?"
At Jin's question, Rata lowered his head.
"It's not a demon, my lord."
"It's not a demon?"
"What is sealed inside is the being who was my father."
Smareon Prochi.
The monster sealed in the basement of Ghost Bird Castle was none other than the previous Ghost Corps commander.
